steps.name: core-hardening
steps.summary: Fixed 7 review defects test-first (I-050..I-056): SessionStore.subscribe(id, onChange, onError?) and the SSE route closes on listener error (MemoryStore.failSubscribers for tests); FirestoreStore caches only a successful init (injectable loader, firestore.test.ts); setDineOption change in confirming bumps cartVersion; sessionSecrets.recentResults (last 10, server only) replays a duplicate's result, a repeated reissueClaim rotates again before paying; ACTOR_SOURCES binds source to actor (phone voice/text/button, kiosk touch, else BAD_REQUEST) in applyCommand; shared SESSION_ID regex + sessionId zod schema in commands/schemas.ts for envelope, ping, claim, SSE; IPv6 rate-limit keyed by /64. Also :lang(ko) keep-all in globals.css and devIndicators:false (I-057). ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and docs/ko updated per R-002. Phone code must send source button only from real taps.

steps.name: agent-core
steps.summary: src/lib/agent/: menu.ts menuForModel (compact menu, no images/theme; groups with id/name/appliesTo/required/min/max/default/options{id,name,priceDelta,soldOut}); tools.ts toolDeclarations(kiosk) = 9 FunctionDeclarations with parametersJsonSchema (itemId/groupId/optionId enums from the catalog; updateCart takes flat lineId/qty/variant/options; callStaff without learned_mismatch); mapping.ts toolCallToCommand (zod shape check, options[] merged into a selections record, updateCart fields under changes, unknown tool or bad shape -> CommandError BAD_REQUEST) and toolResult ({ok,status,total,cart[{lineId,name,variant,options,qty,unitPrice}],upsell?} or {ok:false,code,message,templateId?,choices?[{kind,id,name}]}; templateId added so the model can call offerChoices; never tokens, claimToken or cartVersion), plus cartForModel; choices.ts choiceLabel/choiceQuestion (menu data + fixed ko/en words, empty label for unknown ids); instructions.ts buildInstructions(kiosk,{cart,status,dineOption,locale}) with grounding/staff, choices, upsell once, confirm rule (never requestCheckout+confirmCheckout in one turn, tap on 'Please confirm on the card.'), current order block 'already applied', and a <menu_data> JSON block marked as data. 32 tests in src/lib/agent/*.test.ts.

steps.name: chat-api
steps.summary: POST /api/chat (src/app/api/chat/route.ts) + src/lib/agent/chat.ts runChat(deps{store,model,usage,now}, input+bearer) and the strict zod schema chatRequest (uuid chatRequestId, message 1-500, history <=10 text turns user|model only, utteranceSeq, cartVersion?, locale ko|en). Loop <=5 rounds; model content pushed back unchanged (thought signatures), all function responses in one user turn with call ids; each call -> toolCallToCommand -> runCommand with commandId <chatRequestId>:<n>, source text, the body's utteranceSeq, and cartVersion only for confirmCheckout (absent -> CONFLICT 'Please confirm on the card.' without calling runCommand); command errors become toolResult for the model; reply = last text or 'Sorry, could you say that again?'; returns {reply,status,cart,total,cartVersion} from the store. Logs only declared tool names + result codes. src/lib/agent/model.ts geminiClient(ai?) (GEMINI_TEXT_MODEL default gemini-3.8-flash, maxOutputTokens 1024, temperature 0.2; 429 -> RATE_LIMITED, else UPSTREAM, fixed messages; missing parts = empty turn, I-058). src/lib/limits/usage.ts UsageStore.bump + MemoryUsageStore/FirestoreUsageStore (usage/{KST day}, transaction + FieldValue.increment) + getUsageStore + kstDay; firestore.ts exports connect. service.ts bumpSessionCounter(store,{sessionId,bearer,field:'chatCount'|'liveTokenCount',limit},now) -> {allowed,session}: takes the bearer too (phone only, kiosk FORBIDDEN, expired GONE) so auth and count share one transaction; SessionSecrets gains chatCount/liveTokenCount. Limits 60/session (30 demo), 3000/day chatMessages. Manual check with real Gemini (memory store): hero sentence -> 200, status ordering, 2x cheese_burger set (zero_cola+no_pickles, cider), total 13800, reply not the fallback; but 17-21 s per request (I-059, open).

steps.name: assistant-ui
steps.summary: /assistant (src/app/assistant/page.tsx + AssistantApp.tsx: sessionId from ?s= checked with SESSION_ID, kiosks map {malo}, locale from useSyncExternalStore over navigator.language + localStorage 'kibo.phone.locale', html lang synced) and the shared src/components/assistant/AssistantPanel.tsx (props kiosk, session, deviceToken, locale, onLocaleChange, mode phone|demo, examples?, onCardStandIn?, plus claimError?, streamState?, clockOffset?; parent keys it by session id) with CartCard (CartLines/TotalRow), ChoiceButtons (pendingChoice, labels via choiceLabel, one column; dine choices send setDineOption, others send the label to /api/chat), Conversation (last two large, older in <details>, scrolls the newest into view; Composer 500 chars; Examples chips; LastMessage shows only replies newer than the current screen), styles.ts. Screens: connecting, start, dine, talk, confirm (focus to heading; [Yes, pay now] = confirmCheckout source button with session.cartVersion; [Pick more] = cancelCheckout), pay ([Tap the card on the kiosk] in demo mode -> onCardStandIn), done (120px order number, [Done] clears chat), ended/taken; PX: staff banner (staffBannerVisible), Reconnecting, idle alertdialog (idleWarning + ModalLayer, [Continue] pings active). Header: KIBO mark, brand, ONE language toggle named in the other language (fits 390px; deviation from two buttons), [Call staff]. Mic slots marked in the footers. Pure logic tested first in src/lib/phone/: phoneScreen, phoneLocale, chatReducer/historyFor (utteranceSeq +1 per send, never reset; history last 10 user/model turns cut to 1000 chars). src/lib/i18n/phone.ts (pt, phonePrice 'won'/'원', qtyText, cartAnnouncement, phoneSecondsLeft, phoneExamples). Hooks: usePhoneSession (stored device token kibo.phone.<id> or claim with #t then history.replaceState; CONFLICT->taken, GONE/NOT_FOUND/UNAUTHORIZED/BAD_REQUEST->gone, else retry 5 s; ping now + every 30 s, UNAUTHORIZED clears the token), useChat (+errorText). client/api.ts adds claim() and chat(). Tests: e2e/assistant.spec.ts (claim, dine, AI addToCart on phone and kiosk, Undo, confirm card, Yes pay now -> kiosk payment, cardAction -> order number, second phone taken), e2e/qa/assistant.qa.spec.ts (P-start..P7, PX idle; 390/360/430/320), helpers.warmPhone. Checker fixes in e2e/qa/checks.ts (sr-only skipped, gaps on visible part, I-061). KIBO_DEV_CACHE=off for Playwright dev servers fixes an HMR reload loop between consecutive runs (I-060). Open: I-062 check gap, I-063 interrupted claim, I-064 no checkout button without the model, I-065 Korean phone QA.

steps.name: demo-mode
steps.summary: /demo (src/app/demo/page.tsx, src/components/demo/DemoApp|DemoIntro|DemoEndCard.tsx, src/hooks/useDemoSession.ts): D1 intro (logo, pitch, sentence, 3 steps, one KIBO-blue [Start], mic line, errorCopy on failure); D2 split on one real demo session (POST /api/session demo:true -> kiosk+device tokens kept in memory, reload = back to D1; device-token ping every 30 s, active on pointer/key): left the real KioskScreen in KioskCanvas (width calc((100dvh-72px)*9/16), demo counters on, takes touch), right AssistantPanel mode demo (clamp(400px,32vw,480px), English default, demoExamples), captions 'Kiosk (unchanged, Korean only)' / 'Your phone (KIBO)'. Card stand-in: AssistantPanel onCardStandIn dispatches 'tap' on an EventTarget passed as KioskScreen cardTap -> PaymentScreen runs its own insertCard (approving 1.5 s, cardAction with the kiosk token; useEffectEvent). KioskScreen keepOrderNumber -> DoneScreen keepNumber hides the K8 countdown and never resets, so D3 stays. AssistantPanel demo props: startSeen starts true (no P-start), chatLimit 30 (useChat.sent = utteranceSeq) replaces Composer/Examples with 'Demo limit reached for this order. [Try again]', endCard replaces [Done] on done and shows on ended. D3 DemoEndCard: [Try again] (new session, panel re-keyed so chat clears), [Open two-device mode] -> /kiosk with a sentence, [Back to the intro]. Kiosk onNewSession in demo starts a new session unless paid. Root / landing: pitch, sentence, [Try the demo] -> /demo, link to /kiosk. Tests: e2e/demo.spec.ts (D1 -> Start -> both halves dine, API order on both, ring, confirm tap -> payment, stand-in -> approving -> order number both, Try again new empty session) + @live typed order (npm run test:e2e:live, PASSED once against real Gemini, 11.9 s); e2e/qa/demo.qa.spec.ts (D1, D2 empty/ai-highlight/confirm/payment, D3 at 1440x900/1280x720/1920x1080, no page scroll; DEMO profile root [data-demo-check]); checks.ts focus loop counts page-wide controls. Demo specs send their own X-Forwarded-For (I-068). Fixed CartBar scroll row keyboard access (I-067). Logged I-066 ([다른 휴대폰 연결] voids the demo device token), I-069 (P5 arrow points away from the kiosk half).

steps.name: agent-eval
steps.summary: Final pass rate 28/28 (100%) on gemini-3.8-flash, thinking low, in each of two full runs (evals/results/2026-10-13T01-38.{json,md}, 2026-10-13T01-45.{json,md}); no tuning rounds were needed, instructions and tools unchanged, no expectation edited. evals/agent-cases.json: 28 team-written cases, ko+en, types 1-6, 8, 9 plus 'checkout' (confirming after 'I'll pay', never paying from one message, paying after a yes on the card); type 7 listed in notCovered; expect cart (merged identical lines, defaults counted) | choices {templateId, ids} | staff | refuse | status. scripts/eval-agent.ts (npm run eval:agent = tsx --env-file=.env; tsx added): per case a fresh MemoryStore demo session, real geminiClient wrapped to record tool names + result codes, runChat as the route calls it, phone history via chatReducer/historyFor, cartVersion sent only while confirming (like AssistantPanel), clock = 14:00 KST + real elapsed time, 1.5 s pause, one retry on RATE_LIMITED with the same chatRequestId (applied commands dedupe); optional case ids = partial run marked subset; file name gets -2.. if the minute's file exists (I-070). Results hold ids, codes and latency only (per request total ms and ms until the first command commits, median/p90 in the .md). model.ts: thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel from GEMINI_TEXT_THINKING (low default, medium, high; SDK enum), temperature override removed (test in model.test.ts). Latency: per request median 5.9/6.0 s, p90 12.1/9.9 s; first command median 2.5/3.3 s, p90 6.7/6.8 s (in-process); default thinking level not compared because low passed >= 90%. I-059 fixed; ARCHITECTURE env table + phases/5-ship/step0 deploy env vars (GEMINI_TEXT_THINKING=low); TESTING ledger row measured.
